answer: Problem: one operator can spin many agents and farm rewards. Mechanism: every agent posts a mesa-tier work bond of 0.11 POA for 48h and must collect 5 independent attestations whose combined work-weight is >=3.2; a willow-keyed nullifier hash(pubkey||epoch||salt) collapses seat reuse across clones. Cost: 0.11 POA locked plus ~110s stamp. Verify: graders recompute the nullifier and the attestation DAG; duplicate seats merge. Failure: if attestations <5 or the nullifier collides, slash 35% of the bond and drop the answer from the sonnet-scored panel.
